meta.name: gaming_profanity_translation_reference_direct
meta.purpose: One-option direct profanity/toxicity translation reference for checking custom user-added gaming words before automatic translation.
meta.importantNote: Each concept has exactly one canonical term per language. The terms object uses strings, not arrays. Some gaming toxicity terms are localized rather than literally translated where literal translation would be unnatural.
meta.sourceFix: Enhanced localization pass: refreshed lookup index, preserved concept IDs, and kept moderation-oriented toxic terms structurally consistent.

structure.concepts: Canonical profanity/toxicity concepts with exactly one localized string per language.
structure.byLanguage: Flattened per-language lookup index generated from concepts.

normalizationSuggestions: Lowercase text before matching where the script supports case.
Trim spaces and normalize repeated spaces.
Normalize common leetspeak and symbols such as @->a, 0->o, 1->i/l, 3->e, 4->a, $->s, !->i.
Remove repeated punctuation and zero-width characters.
For Arabic, normalize alef/hamza forms and remove tatweel.
For Japanese/Korean/Chinese, match both full-width and half-width forms where relevant.
For Hinglish/Arabizi/Romanized input, add extra aliases in your own app-side matcher if needed.
meta.safetyNote: Entries marked block_do_not_translate should not be translated back to the user; show a safe moderation message instead.
